<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sysevent_script_action"><sysevent_script_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><condition_script/><description/><event_name>x_enno_gatenow.review.assigned</event_name><name>Assignment Group Review Notification</name><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[(function runAction(current, event, gs) {

    var groupId = event.parm1;

    var ga = new GlideAggregate('x_enno_gatenow_grant_review');
    ga.addQuery('assignment_group', groupId);
    ga.addQuery('status', 'review_in_progress');
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();

    if (ga.next()) {
        var count = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);

        if (count == 1) {
            gs.eventQueue(
                "review.group.notification",
                null,
                groupId,
                count
            );
        }
    }

})(current, event, gs);]]></script><synchronous>false</synchronous><sys_class_name>sysevent_script_action</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>umar.farooq</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-03 15:25:31</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>fc744511eb400fd0520dfbdffdc0cd1c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Assignment Group Review Notification</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="GateNow" source="x_enno_gatenow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="GateNow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysevent_script_action_fc744511eb400fd0520dfbdffdc0cd1c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>umar.farooq</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-03 15:25:31</sys_updated_on></sysevent_script_action></record_update>
